name: context-lens
description: Sets the reasoning effort for every prompt automatically, and shows the prompt-cache timers, context window and rate-limit usage above the prompt. A fork of HeyCubit/effortless (MIT).

handoffSkill.title: Handoff skill (optional)
handoffSkill.description: A skill or slash command that writes the Full handoff, e.g. session-handoff. Empty: Context Lens writes it itself (checks git, saves HANDOFF.md). Quick is always a fast fork with the built-in prompt.

handoffAfter.title: After a handoff (first choice)
handoffAfter.description: What the handoff bar starts on; it then remembers your last choice. continue: clear and carry on. confirm: clear, the new chat says where things stand and waits. copy: keep the chat and copy the handoff.

effortBias.title: Effort slider
effortBias.description: -2 cheaper to 2 smarter. Tips the judge's close calls that way; sure calls stay. 0: as the judge says.

effortFloor.title: Never below
effortFloor.description: Auto never picks a lower effort than this.

effortCeiling.title: Never above
effortCeiling.description: Auto never picks a higher effort than this.

hide.title: Switched off
hide.description: Comma-separated: handoff (the Hand off button), timer (the cache timer), reason (the judge line), swamp (the context alert), hot (the running-hot alert), cold (the cold-cache alert). Empty shows everything.

subagents.title: Effort for subagents
subagents.description: on: every subagent the chat sends off gets an effort picked by the judge before it starts, so a quick search runs at low instead of the chat's effort. off (default): subagents run at the chat's effort. Either way a subagent keeps an effort its definition or its Agent call sets, unless Override definitions is on (an Agent call's own always stays).

subagentModel.title: Cheaper model for subagents
subagentModel.description: on (needs Effort for subagents on): a subagent the judge is sure is simple runs on a cheaper model than the one it was given (never a dearer one, never Fable). A subagent starts with a small context and a cache of its own, so the switch costs next to nothing there. off (default): a subagent keeps the model it was given. A model its definition or its Agent call sets is kept, unless Override definitions is on (an Agent call's own always stays).

overrideDefinitions.title: Override definitions
overrideDefinitions.description: off (default): a subagent keeps the model and effort its definition's frontmatter sets, and Context Lens steers only what it inherits. on: the judge's picks replace a definition's model and effort too. A model or effort the Agent call names itself is never replaced.

holdOffer.title: Hold the prompt for a model offer
holdOffer.description: on (default): with model on Manual, a typed prompt waits for Switch, Keep or Don't ask again when the judge names another model. off: the offer shows above the prompt and the prompt goes on. never: the judge never suggests a model. With model on Auto the switch or hand-off happens without asking, whichever is set.

handoffButton.title: Hand off button
handoffButton.description: advised: the button is Compact, and turns into a glowing Hand off when Haiku says a fresh chat would pay off. always: the button is always Hand off.

compactWith.title: Compact with
compactWith.description: haiku: Haiku 5.5 writes the summary when the chat is compacted (far cheaper). session: the chat's own model, as Claude Code does it.

swampAt.title: Context alert at
swampAt.description: The context alert shows once the context fills this percent of the window.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: The accent colour of everything Context Lens draws. violet: the brand colour. orange: Claude Code orange. rose: cherry-blossom pink, with falling petals.

layout.title: Look
layout.description: default: a dashboard band above the prompt (effort, Auto, cache, context, handoff). minimal: small buttons in the footer, no band.
